# ORB-SLAM3 and its bundled dependencies, built from *our* CMake rather than
# theirs.
#
# Upstream's build system is deliberately not used (no add_subdirectory of
# ORB_SLAM3/CMakeLists.txt) because it:
#   * declares `cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 2.8)`, which CMake >= 4 rejects
#     outright,
#   * appends `-march=native -O3 -Wall` and `-std=c++11` to the *global*
#     CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS, which would leak into every target in this project,
#   * builds shared libs into its own source tree.
#
# Compiling the same source files ourselves costs one file list to keep in
# sync (checked against upstream's CMakeLists at the pinned commit) and buys
# full control of flags, standard, and output location.

set(ORB_SLAM3_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ORB_SLAM3)

if(NOT EXISTS ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "third_party/ORB_SLAM3 is empty. Run: git submodule update --init --recursive")
endif()

find_package(OpenCV 4.4 REQUIRED)
find_package(Eigen3 3.1.0 REQUIRED)
# Prefer the submodule build tree over any system-wide Pangolin, so the
# version ORB-SLAM3's Viewer/MapDrawer are compiled against is the pinned one.
find_package(Pangolin REQUIRED
    PATHS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Pangolin/build
    NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
find_package(Boost REQUIRED COMPONENTS serialization)
find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED)

# Warnings from vendored third-party code are noise we can't act on: silence
# them so real warnings from our own modules stay visible. -g0 goes with them:
# debug info for code we do not debug turned liborb_slam3.a into a ~900MB
# archive under RelWithDebInfo, and dominated both build time and link time.
set(ORB_SLAM3_QUIET_FLAGS -w -g0)

# C++14, not this project's C++20: ORB-SLAM3 (and the DBoW2/g2o it bundles)
# predate C++17's removal of `++` on bool, which LoopClosing.cc relies on.
# Building the vendored code at its own standard keeps the submodule pristine
# - no patch to carry across upstream updates - and the standard version does
# not leak out, because `slam/` links these targets PRIVATE and no
# ORB-SLAM3 header appears in any header we expose.
set(ORB_SLAM3_CXX_STANDARD 14)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- DBoW2 -----
add_library(orb_dbow2 STATIC
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/DBoW2/DBoW2/BowVector.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/DBoW2/DBoW2/FeatureVector.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/DBoW2/DBoW2/FORB.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/DBoW2/DBoW2/ScoringObject.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/DBoW2/DUtils/Random.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/DBoW2/DUtils/Timestamp.cpp
)
target_include_directories(orb_dbow2 SYSTEM PUBLIC
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/DBoW2
)
target_link_libraries(orb_dbow2 PUBLIC ${OpenCV_LIBS})
target_compile_options(orb_dbow2 PRIVATE ${ORB_SLAM3_QUIET_FLAGS})
set_target_properties(orb_dbow2 PROPERTIES
    CXX_STANDARD ${ORB_SLAM3_CXX_STANDARD} CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ g2o -----
# g2o's config.h is normally generated by its own CMake; generate it into the
# build tree so the source submodule stays pristine.
#
# Its headers reach for it as `#include "../../config.h"`, which the
# preprocessor resolves relative to the *including header's* directory before
# consulting -I paths - so no include directory can satisfy it directly.
# Mirroring g2o's directory depth in the build tree does: with config.h at
# <gen>/config.h and <gen>/g2o/core on the include path, the literal
# "../../config.h" lookup lands exactly on the generated file.
set(G2O_CONFIG_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/g2o_generated)
configure_file(
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/config.h.in
    ${G2O_CONFIG_DIR}/config.h)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${G2O_CONFIG_DIR}/g2o/core ${G2O_CONFIG_DIR}/g2o/types
                    ${G2O_CONFIG_DIR}/g2o/stuff ${G2O_CONFIG_DIR}/g2o/solvers)

add_library(orb_g2o STATIC
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/batch_stats.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/cache.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/estimate_propagator.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/factory.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/hyper_dijkstra.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/hyper_graph_action.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/hyper_graph.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/jacobian_workspace.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/marginal_covariance_cholesky.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/matrix_structure.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/optimizable_graph.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/optimization_algorithm.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/optimization_algorithm_dogleg.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/optimization_algorithm_factory.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/optimization_algorithm_gauss_newton.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/optimization_algorithm_levenberg.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/optimization_algorithm_with_hessian.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/parameter_container.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/parameter.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/robust_kernel.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/robust_kernel_factory.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/robust_kernel_impl.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/solver.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core/sparse_optimizer.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/stuff/property.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/stuff/string_tools.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/stuff/timeutil.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/types/types_sba.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/types/types_seven_dof_expmap.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/types/types_six_dof_expmap.cpp
    # sparse_block_matrix_test.cpp and se3mat.cpp are upstream test/scratch
    # files with their own main(); intentionally excluded.
)
target_include_directories(orb_g2o SYSTEM PUBLIC
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/core
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/types
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/g2o/g2o/stuff
    ${G2O_CONFIG_DIR}
    ${G2O_CONFIG_DIR}/g2o/core
    ${G2O_CONFIG_DIR}/g2o/types
    ${G2O_CONFIG_DIR}/g2o/stuff
    ${G2O_CONFIG_DIR}/g2o/solvers
    ${EIGEN3_INCLUDE_DIR}
)
target_compile_options(orb_g2o PRIVATE ${ORB_SLAM3_QUIET_FLAGS})
set_target_properties(orb_g2o PROPERTIES
    CXX_STANDARD ${ORB_SLAM3_CXX_STANDARD} CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# ------------------------------------------------- upstream bug fix ---------
# Map::PreSave() crashes when saving any map built from a real flight.
#
# Both of its MapPoint loops walk `mspMapPoints` with a range-for while the
# body can erase from that very set:
#
#   MapPoint::EraseObservation()  ->  nObs <= 2  ->  MapPoint::SetBadFlag()
#     ->  Map::EraseMapPoint()    ->  mspMapPoints.erase()
#
# The freed red-black-tree node is then dereferenced by the loop's own ++it,
# so the process dies in std::_Rb_tree_increment. It only triggers when map
# points lose observations during the save - which means sessions that lost
# tracking or merged maps, i.e. every real flight of any length and no short
# synthetic one. The cost is the entire mapping run, at the very last moment.
#
# Fix: iterate a snapshot. Applied to a COPY of Map.cc in the build tree, so
# the submodule checkout stays pristine and `git submodule update` never has
# to fight a local edit. If upstream ever changes these lines, configuring
# fails loudly rather than silently building unpatched code.
set(ORB_SLAM3_PATCHED_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/orb_slam3_patched)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${ORB_SLAM3_PATCHED_DIR})

file(READ ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/Map.cc ORB_SLAM3_MAP_SOURCE)

# Loop 1: strips observations that belong to other maps. EraseObservation()
# can bad-flag the point, which erases it from mspMapPoints mid-iteration.
set(ORB_SLAM3_MAP_FIND_1 [==[    int nMPWithoutObs = 0;
    for(MapPoint* pMPi : mspMapPoints)]==])
set(ORB_SLAM3_MAP_REPLACE_1 [==[    int nMPWithoutObs = 0;
    // PATCHED by third_party/CMakeLists.txt: this loop body can erase from
    // mspMapPoints via MapPoint::SetBadFlag(), so iterate a snapshot.
    const std::vector<MapPoint*> vpSnapshotForObservations(
        mspMapPoints.begin(), mspMapPoints.end());
    for(MapPoint* pMPi : vpSnapshotForObservations)]==])

# Loop 2: MapPoint::PreSave() itself calls EraseObservation(), same chain.
# Its own snapshot (taken after loop 1) keeps the original semantics exactly.
set(ORB_SLAM3_MAP_FIND_2 [==[    // Backup of MapPoints
    mvpBackupMapPoints.clear();
    for(MapPoint* pMPi : mspMapPoints)]==])
set(ORB_SLAM3_MAP_REPLACE_2 [==[    // Backup of MapPoints
    mvpBackupMapPoints.clear();
    // PATCHED by third_party/CMakeLists.txt: MapPoint::PreSave() can erase
    // from mspMapPoints via SetBadFlag(), so iterate a snapshot.
    const std::vector<MapPoint*> vpSnapshotForBackup(
        mspMapPoints.begin(), mspMapPoints.end());
    for(MapPoint* pMPi : vpSnapshotForBackup)]==])

foreach(index RANGE 1 2)
    string(FIND "${ORB_SLAM3_MAP_SOURCE}" "${ORB_SLAM3_MAP_FIND_${index}}" found)
    if(found EQUAL -1)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "Cannot apply the Map::PreSave fix (pattern ${index} not found in "
            "${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/Map.cc). The pinned ORB-SLAM3 commit has "
            "changed; re-check whether the iterator-invalidation bug is still "
            "present before removing this patch.")
    endif()
    string(REPLACE "${ORB_SLAM3_MAP_FIND_${index}}" "${ORB_SLAM3_MAP_REPLACE_${index}}"
           ORB_SLAM3_MAP_SOURCE "${ORB_SLAM3_MAP_SOURCE}")
endforeach()

# Via a staging file so the compiled copy is only touched when it actually
# changes, instead of forcing a rebuild on every configure.
file(WRITE ${ORB_SLAM3_PATCHED_DIR}/Map.cc.staged "${ORB_SLAM3_MAP_SOURCE}")
configure_file(${ORB_SLAM3_PATCHED_DIR}/Map.cc.staged
               ${ORB_SLAM3_PATCHED_DIR}/Map.cc COPYONLY)

# ------------------------------------------------------------ ORB-SLAM3 -----
add_library(orb_slam3 STATIC
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/System.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/Tracking.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/LocalMapping.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/LoopClosing.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/ORBextractor.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/ORBmatcher.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/FrameDrawer.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/Converter.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/MapPoint.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/KeyFrame.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/Atlas.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_PATCHED_DIR}/Map.cc   # patched copy - see above
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/MapDrawer.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/Optimizer.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/Frame.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/KeyFrameDatabase.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/Sim3Solver.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/Viewer.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/ImuTypes.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/G2oTypes.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/CameraModels/Pinhole.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/CameraModels/KannalaBrandt8.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/OptimizableTypes.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/MLPnPsolver.cpp
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/GeometricTools.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/TwoViewReconstruction.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/Config.cc
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/src/Settings.cc
)
target_include_directories(orb_slam3 SYSTEM PUBLIC
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/include
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/include/CameraModels
    ${ORB_SLAM3_DIR}/Thirdparty/Sophus
    ${EIGEN3_INCLUDE_DIR}
    ${Pangolin_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)
target_link_libraries(orb_slam3 PUBLIC
    ${OpenCV_LIBS}
    ${Pangolin_LIBRARIES}
    orb_dbow2
    orb_g2o
    Boost::serialization
    OpenSSL::Crypto
)
target_compile_options(orb_slam3 PRIVATE ${ORB_SLAM3_QUIET_FLAGS})
# Upstream guards its steady_clock usage behind this; without it the code
# falls back to std::chrono::monotonic_clock, which no longer exists.
target_compile_definitions(orb_slam3 PRIVATE COMPILEDWITHC11)
set_target_properties(orb_slam3 PROPERTIES
    CXX_STANDARD ${ORB_SLAM3_CXX_STANDARD} CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
